Nnuru ne kuadwuma

Ɛka Al Sheikh Investment Group ho

Yɛn nnuru ne kuadwuma dwumadi de adwene si petrochemicals ne nnuru a yɛhwehwɛ ma adwuma adetɔfo so. Mpɔtam ne amanaman ntam nneɛma-yɛfo nkitahodi boa nneɛma-ma nhyehyɛe yi.

Kuw no ka ne nkitahodi a ɛwɔ UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Bahrain ne Russia ho asɛm. Ne yɛn adwumayɛfo mmɔ nneɛma ne nneɛma-ma ahiade a ɛfata wo adwuma ho nkɔmmɔ.
